title: Which club will Mohamed Salah join first after leaving Liverpool at the end of the 2025–26 season?
background: Mohamed Salah has announced that he will leave Liverpool at the end of the season.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : An official announcement from Salah or his new club, or reliable news reporting confirming a completed signing. 
  Resolution Condition : Resolve to the first club with which Salah signs a senior playing contract following his departure from Liverpool at the end of the 2025–26 season. Transfer speculation, negotiations, and trial appearances do not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the club.
